title: GF(2^571) batch mul via multi-word VPCLMULQDQ
description:
Add SIMD multi-word multiply for GF($2^{571}$). Used in NIST B-571 / K-571 elliptic-curve research; currently zero SIMD path despite VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM being well-suited to multi-word polynomial products.

## Background

`crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs` handles GF($2^m$) for $m > 64$ via scalar multi-word arithmetic. At $m = 571$ every multiply is $9 \times 9$ word-pair scalar XORs and shifts.

The fix walks PPC steps:

- V3 SIMD: 2D VPCLMULQDQ scheduler — process pairs of u64 word products per VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM instruction, accumulate the partial-product matrix.
- V4 register tile: schedule the $9 \times 9$ word-pair fan to keep partial products in YMM registers as long as possible.

Wire via `simd::maybe_gf2m_wide()` (extend the existing `maybe_gf2m_wide256` if applicable, or add new).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. scalar wide multiply at $m = 571$ across the existing test suite.
- [hard] Reduction polynomial handling unchanged (uses `primitive_polys` table).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd`.
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact regenerated and shows VPCLMULQDQ on YMM.
- [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded.
- [aspirational] $\geq 1.5\times$ geomean on `gf2m_wide_mul` bench at the $m=571$ size class.

## Notes

Bench: `gf2m_wide_mul` (existing, pinned by I1). Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
